items.title: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
items.summary: The vessel's captain was killed and 11 crew members were rescued after the attack on the Turkish-owned ship, Ukraine's leader says.

confirmed_facts.text: An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first.

confirmed_facts.text: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex It’s launching textGrain watermarking in the EU, but OpenAI says it won’t be the ‘global default’ yet.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex It’s launching textGrain watermarking in the EU, but OpenAI says it won’t be the ‘global default’ yet.

confirmed_facts.text: OpenAI says its textGrain watermarking “matched or exceeded” other approaches like Google DeepMind’s SynthID for text, which is also the basis for the watermarking Anthropic announced in August.

confirmed_facts.text: But it notes that textGrain “does not guarantee reliable detection,” and says text watermarks don’t verify accuracy, determine who owns the text, measure how much a human contributed, or prove human authorship.

items.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
items.summary: Trust gaps in the new protocol spread malicious prompts from one agent to another.

confirmed_facts.text: The adoption of AI agents in millions of organizations is creating new opportunities for attackers to make them take malicious actions, such as exfiltrating database contents and sensitive business and personal information.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The adoption of AI agents in millions of organizations is creating new opportunities for attackers to make them take malicious actions, such as exfiltrating database contents and sensitive business and personal information.

confirmed_facts.text: In the past five months, Google and four other organizations—with little in common except for their use of AI agents—have acknowledged vulnerabilities that exploit one agent inside a targeted network to spread harmful instructions to other internal agents.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: In the past five months, Google and four other organizations—with little in common except for their use of AI agents—have acknowledged vulnerabilities that exploit one agent inside a targeted network to spread harmful instructions to other internal agents.

confirmed_facts.text: Guardrails inside such agents, if they exist at all, are often lax and will send the instructions to other agents down the chain.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Guardrails inside such agents, if they exist at all, are often lax and will send the instructions to other agents down the chain.

confirmed_facts.text: Because the latter agent explicitly trusts the first one, it follows the directions.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Because the latter agent explicitly trusts the first one, it follows the directions.

confirmed_facts.text: Unexpected and hard to mitigate Independent researcher Syed Anas Mohiuddin tested agents from organizations including Google, JP Morgan Chase, Weviate, Rapid7, the French government’s interministerial digital directorate, and the US federal government.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Unexpected and hard to mitigate Independent researcher Syed Anas Mohiuddin tested agents from organizations including Google, JP Morgan Chase, Weviate, Rapid7, the French government’s interministerial digital directorate, and the US federal government.

confirmed_facts.text: His proof-of-concept attacks exploit trust gaps in MCP, short for Model Context Protocol.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: His proof-of-concept attacks exploit trust gaps in MCP, short for Model Context Protocol.
